checkpoint.title: Five species, out of Wild Zone 1

events.why: step 64: the lab gate asks for five registered species, 3/5 after the tutorial: two new ones here in Wild Zone 1 before leaving, Scatterbug (on the road at 100 from the far gate) and Mareep (in the grass right of the road at 60), so the gate's scene finds 5/5 (user, 2026-11-13; console B 2026-11-13 caught only Scatterbug with one wanted). Patrol 100, 60, 100, 60, ...: walking to 100 and back brings Pokemon back at 60; 10 visits, 10 minutes, 12 throws at most. Only the Pokedex's "Registered!" banner counts, since repeats (Fletchling, Bunnelby) do not register; the mission panel's counter is not read (catch_in_zone). At thorough checks, or when its own count is not sure (a catch seen only by the plate, a rerun seeing only caught species, or short), the Pokedex's count decides: 5 or fail inside the zone (no reader for the Pokedex screen yet: until then its own count decides).

step 62: on across Wild Zone 1 to its far gate's "A Leave": back onto the road at the catch spots (60, and 100 first when further) and from there by the objective marker. A walk straight at the marker from the last catch (96) left the zone on its west side and pressed into a building, last read 49 (console B, 2026-11-13). On the marker with no prompt counts as through the gate (walk_to_zone_gate).
step 62: A Leave, out on the street (a plain scene step ends at once on the gate's prompt with the party bar up; console B, 2026-11-10)

metadata.source: console B recording, 2026-11-08/09: played step by step from a new game. Ends out on the street just through the far gate (user, 2026-11-14); the walk on into the lab is 03.08b. Short on species, it fails inside the zone (catch_more_species)
